sloka: भवन्तः कृतशास्त्रार्था बुद्ध्या च परिनिष्ठिताः ।सम्भूय च मदर्थो ऽयमन्वेष्टव्यो नरेश्वराः ।। ७.४४.२० ॥
transliteration: bhavantaḥ kṛtaśāstrārthā buddhyā ca pariniṣṭhitāḥ ।sambhūya ca madartho 'yamanveṣṭavyo nareśvarāḥ ।। 7.44.20 ॥

translations.english: Rama further stated that since they were learned in scriptures and perfected in intellect, they should all together investigate this matter of his.
